TV’s biggest night has arrived. The winners of the 78th annual Emmy Awards were announced live from the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles on September 14th, at a ceremony hosted by four-time Emmy winner Mariska Hargitay.

Join Backstage to access jobs you can apply to right now!

Matthew Rhys won lead acting Emmys in both the limited series and comedy categories, for “The Beast in Me” and “Widow’s Bay.” It was a strong debut night for “Widow’s Bay,” which also took outstanding comedy series along with writing and directing honors.

“The Pitt” won outstanding drama series, with a lead actor win for Noah Wyle. Jean Smart closed out “Hacks” with a win for lead actress in a comedy — her eighth career Emmy.
